api-reference.label: API Reference
api-reference.description: Reference documentation describing the endpoints, parameters, authentication, and responses of an API.

architecture-documentation.label: Architecture Documentation
architecture-documentation.description: Documentation that describes the architecture of a system, including diagrams and design decisions.

case-study.label: Case Study
case-study.description: A narrative account of a documentation project, including challenges, approach, deliverables, and outcomes.

conceptual-guide.label: Conceptual Guide
conceptual-guide.description: Documentation that explains concepts, architecture, and background information to help readers understand a product or technology.

developer-guide.label: Developer Guide
developer-guide.description: Documentation aimed at developers, providing conceptual and procedural information for building with a product or API.

governance-record.label: Governance Record
governance-record.description: Documentation that records decisions, actions, and attendees for governance processes.

integration-guide.label: Integration Guide
integration-guide.description: Documentation that explains how to integrate a product or service with other systems, often including workflows and code examples.

portfolio-page.label: Portfolio Page
portfolio-page.description: A page in a portfolio that presents the author's work, skills, or tools.

qa-report.label: QA Report
qa-report.description: A report that presents the results of quality assurance checks on documentation.

release-notes.label: Release Notes
release-notes.description: Documentation that describes the changes, new features, and fixes in a software release.

sdk-documentation.label: SDK Documentation
sdk-documentation.description: Documentation that explains how to use a software development kit, including installation, configuration, and usage.

skill-page.label: Skill Page
skill-page.description: A page that describes a specific skill or capability.

tool-page.label: Tool Page
tool-page.description: A page that describes a specific tool or technology used in documentation work.

tutorial.label: Tutorial
tutorial.description: Step-by-step instructional content that guides users through a task or process.

user-guide.label: User Guide
user-guide.description: Documentation that provides instructions for end users on how to use a product or system.
